name: Microgrid multiple-PCC synchronising selection
summary: Selects the named interconnection point and voltage references for the assigned synchronising transaction.
description: Selects the named interconnection point and voltage references for the assigned synchronising transaction. Synchronising control compares two AC systems before their assigned connecting breaker closes. Voltage magnitude, frequency, phase relationship, breaker readiness and command authority are separate inputs to the closing decision.

In a microgrid reconnecting at its point of common coupling, a synchroniser can adjust the island reference while a separate permissive confirms the permitted relationship across the open breaker. For this reference, the drawing identifies “PCC selection and topology” at the input and “Selected synchronising interface” at the output. The other interconnection paths must be considered.

Identify the two measurement sides and the equipment receiving any adjustment request. Closing limits, breaker timing and loss-of-measurement behavior require the approved synchronising design. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
